ITEM 1 | Dark red-purple kidney-shaped beans, glossy and smooth-skinned, whole, clustered in a mound on the upper right of the plate, roughly 8 cm across, about 2 cm tall, with a small bright green leaf tucked among them | 110
ITEM 2 | Light brown granular grain, appears cooked and fluffy with separate grains, slightly matte, forming a mound about 8 cm by 5 cm and 1.5 cm high in the center-right of the plate, with a few darker flecks | 150
ITEM 3 | Orange carrot rounds, sliced about 0.5 cm thick, some whole rounds about 4 cm across and some halved, slightly glossy and moist, scattered in the lower left and center of the plate | 90
ITEM 4 | Thin green beans, bright to olive green, whole and cut into 6 to 8 cm lengths, slightly wilted with a faint sheen, lying across the lower-middle of the plate | 35
ITEM 5 | Pale yellow-cream onion or squash-like pieces, sliced in thin wedges about 3 cm long, lightly browned at edges, glossy and soft, mixed among the vegetables in the lower center | 30
ITEM 6 | Reddish-brown mixed grain pieces, slightly chewy and matte, scattered with the vegetables in the lower center and beneath the carrots, about 1 cm grain size | 40
ITEM 7 | Small pale yellow-brown cubed or chunked pieces, lightly browned and slightly glossy, about 2 cm, sitting at the bottom edge near the carrots | 20
